title: Lab-02 candidate: cumulative evidence and models

questions.prompt: Virtual lab 2: original bounded data evidence. Authored form A. Four independently prepared cultures each have matched ligand exposure verified. Their background-corrected signaling trajectories at 0,10,30 min are (0,50,10), (0,60,20), (0,70,30), (0,80,40). Two technical wells are averaged within each culture. Use trapezoidal area in bare readout-minutes. An upstream perturbation suppresses output with target engagement; downstream bypass restores it. Direct feedback activity and intervention specificity are unmeasured.

response_fields.prompt: Calculate the equal-culture mean trapezoidal area from 0 to 30 min on a bare readout-minute scale. Report exactly 3 significant figures.

options: The perturbation/bypass pattern is consistent with upstream dependence in this model; it does not exclude parallel routes or off-target effects.
Target engagement proves the downstream effect has no alternative.
Bypass proves one unique native pathway.
Only add more wells from one culture.
Measure ligand, receptor state and feedback over time with matched independent cultures and an orthogonal intervention.
Assume every declining trace is a direct measurement of feedback.
